xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4435: Overdeck Anywhere P0: Settings UI for scoped access tokens + require_token_mint toggle

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere P0: Settings UI for scoped access tokens + require_token_mint toggle
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-2351 shipped scoped access tokens (routes GET/POST /api/access-tokens, DELETE /api/access-tokens/:id, pan token) but the dashboard has no UI for them. dashboard.require_token_mint is enforced but lives only in raw config.yaml, has no schema entry, no Settings toggle, and is cached for the process lifetime, so changing it needs a restart.
narratives.Proposal: Add an Access Tokens Settings section (list, one-time-plaintext create dialog, confirmed revoke, 403 explanation) and a 'Require a token to sign in' toggle row in it. Add a dashboard schema module (schema-dashboard.ts), a non-throwing normalizer, and the settings-api GET/PUT mapping, with GET reporting the enforced value and PUT preserving the block when absent. saveSettingsApi calls a renamed invalidateRemoteAccessConfig() so the toggle applies without a restart. Docs updated in remote-access.mdx and DASHBOARD-AUTH.md; verified in an isolated Playwright context against a throwaway dashboard.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing who may create or revoke tokens, or the scope model (PAN-2351 owns both)
- Letting a paired device create or revoke tokens, or hiding the toggle from device sessions
- Reading require_token_mint from a project .pan.yaml, or watching config.yaml for hand edits
- Showing or managing paired devices in the Access Tokens section
- A /ws/terminal heartbeat (PAN-4434)
- New HTTP routes or edits to src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts (at its size cap)
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap
- Committed screenshots
- Storing or logging the plaintext token anywhere outside the create dialog's component state

autoDecisions.summary: Settings GET reports require_token_mint from readRemoteAccessConfig(), not from the merged config
autoDecisions.rationale: The merged config folds in project .pan.yaml, which enforcement never reads; a security toggle must show the enforced value (D-1).

autoDecisions.summary: Invalid require_token_mint values normalize to false and never throw
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing enforcement reader exactly and avoids failing the whole config load (D-2).

autoDecisions.summary: PUT without a dashboard block leaves config.yaml's dashboard block untouched
autoDecisions.rationale: Delete-on-absent (the remote pattern) would let any client that omits the block silently turn the security flag off (D-3).

autoDecisions.summary: Rename _resetRemoteAccessConfigForTests to invalidateRemoteAccessConfig and call it from saveSettingsApi
autoDecisions.rationale: One variant per operation; every save path invalidates; routes/settings.ts is at its size cap (D-4).

autoDecisions.summary: Frontend scope list is a local constant with a root-vitest parity test
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend cannot import src/lib; moving six strings into @overdeck/contracts would touch the security module and the contracts build (D-5).

autoDecisions.summary: One 'Access Tokens' nav entry after 'Remote'; the toggle row is the section's first row
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names one nav entry; the flag is the access-control setting the tokens exist for (D-6).

autoDecisions.summary: UAT evidence goes in the PR body, not committed screenshots
autoDecisions.rationale: An images/ path would push the plan past the six-subsystem lint limit (D-9).

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4435.md WI-2 and decisions D-1, D-3. In src/lib/settings-api.ts: add `dashboard?: { require_token_mint?: boolean }` to ApiSettingsConfig after `remote?`; in loadSettingsApi return `dashboard: { require_token_mint: readRemoteAccessConfig().requireTokenMint }` (import from './remote-access/config.js' — the enforced value, not the merged config); in writeYamlConfigPreservingComments touch ['dashboard'] only when isRecord(config.dashboard), via setBlockMergePreserving, and NEVER delete the block when absent; in saveSettingsApi yamlConfig add `dashboard: settings.dashboard`; in updateSettingsApi merge `dashboard: { ...current.dashboard, ...updates.dashboard }`; in validateSettingsApi push 'dashboard must be an object' or 'dashboard.require_token_mint must be a boolean'. Implementation checkpoint: if lint-file-size fails for settings-api.ts, move the validator into src/lib/settings-api-dashboard.ts as validateDashboardSettings(value): string[]; never raise the cap. narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4435.md WI-8. Verification only: edit a file only to fix a defect this check finds. npm run build, then start node dist/dashboard/server.js under Node 22 on a free port with OVERDECK_HOME set to a new temp directory (minimal config.yaml enabling one provider) and its own OVERDECK_INTERNAL_TOKEN — never the operator's ~/.overdeck or live dashboard. Use an isolated Playwright browser context on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/settings#access-tokens and run the four ordered steps in the PRD. A fresh context opened while the toggle is on shows the HTTP 401 session banner by design. If the server cannot start, report the blocker with pan tell. Paste the results into the PR body.
